widgetTool.name: epp_carousel
widgetTool.description: Emit a catalogue of EPP-eligible purchases (max 6 items) for the customer to select. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Let me show you your eligible purchases.' Emit it whenever widgets_enabled=True, INCLUDING while you are speaking -- on a voice-enabled webchat the customer has both ears and a screen, so showing and speaking are complementary, not alternatives. Speak a short line and emit the widget. Only describe it aloud instead when widgets_enabled=False.

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'epp_carousel'

products.description: Required. Ordered list of gadgets to display. The card frames the product image, name, and a 'From CAD X/mo' line. Retail price and interest live in the plan selector, not here.

category.description: smartphone | laptop | tablet | audio | wearable | console | home.

cta_value.description: Sent back to the agent on tap, e.g. 'epp_select:iphone-17-pro-256'.

from_monthly_cad.description: Lowest monthly figure across available tenures. Rendered large. This is what the customer decides on.

image_url.description: Public image URL. Prefer manufacturer press images.

retail_price_cad.description: Full retail price in CAD. Rendered small, below the fold.

tagline.description: Short aspirational line under the name.

subtitle.description: Widget subheader text. Keep it aspirational, not price-heavy. Never mention interest here.

title.description: Widget header title, e.g. 'Own it sooner'.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'
